paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Kaisar Augustas in khovel tengteng min khum ding thu apia hi.
heading: Jesu Pianna / (Mat 1.18-25)

paite: Huai tuh Siria gam a gam-ukpa Kurini ahih lai a minkhumna masapen ahi.
Huchi in mi tengteng amin uh khum ding in akhua chiat uah ahoh uhi.
Huan Joseph leng, David inkuante leh asuan ahihman in Galili gam a Nazaret a kipan in, Judia gam a David khua Bethlehem ah ahoh hi.
Azikham Mari gaisan lai toh, min khum ding in.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a a-om lai un, anau neih ahong hun hi.
Huan ata masa in pasal aneikhia a; puan in atuam a, khualbuk a atak louh ziak un gan anpiakna ah asial hi.
Huan huai gam mah ah belamchingte a-om ua, gamlak ah zan in abelamhonte uh aching uhi.
heading: Belamchingte' Vehna

paite: Toupa angel khat akiang uah ahong dingh a, Toupa thupina in akim uh atanvak a; huchi in alauta mahmah uhi.
Huan angel in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, ngai un, michih a ding in tanchinhoih kipahhuai mahmah ka hon tut ahi.
Tuni in nou a ding in David khua ah Hondampa apiangta, amah Khrist Toupa ahi.
Hiai nou a ding in chiamtehna ding ahi; naungek puan a tuam, gan anpiakna kuang a lum na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huan angel kiang ah van mipihon ahong omkhawm guih ua, Pathian aphat ua;
"Tungnungpen ah Pathian thupi henla, leitung a akipahpih mahmah mihingte lak ah lemthu leng hen,” achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, angelte'n van a apaisantak un, belamchingte'n, "Tu'n ah Bethlehem kho pha in pai lehang, Toupa'n thu ahon hilh hong tung i en ding uh," akichi uhi.
Huchi in apai mengmeng ua, Mari toh, Joseph toh, gan anpiakna kuang a naungek lum ava mu uhi.
Ava muh un hiai naungek tanchin angel in ahilh agenthangta uhi.
Aza peuhmah in belamchingte thugen lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Mari in thugen tengteng alungtang in angaihtuah a, avom gige hi.
Belamchingte'n angel hilh bang ngei a bangkim amuh ua azak ziak un, Pathian pahtawi leh phat kawm zel in akik nawnta uhi.
Huan azeksum ni ding ni giat ahong chin in, amin ding in, sul a a-om ma a angel in agensa, Jesu asa uhi.
heading: Jesu Min Phuahna Leh Latna

paite: Mosi Dan bang a akisiansakna ni uh ahong tun in, Jerusalem ah amah ava tonpihtou uh; Toupa kiang a amah lan ding in.
Toupa thu a, "Ta pasal sul hong peuhmah Toupa a ding a sehtuam achi ding uh," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
Toupa Dan gen bang a vakhu kop khat hiam vapalnou nih hiam kithoihna lan ding in.
Huan ngai in, Jerusalem ah mi khat amin Simeon a-om a; huai mi midiktat leh Pathian limsak ahi a, Israelte khamuanpa ding angak gige a, atung ah Kha Siangthou a-om hi.
heading: Simeon Kipahthu Genna La

paite: Toupa Khrist amuh masiah zaw asi kei ding chih Kha Siangthou in ana theisak him ahi.
Kha theihsak in tempul ah ava lut a; naungek Jesu, anu leh apa'n dan ngeina bang a atung a hihsak ding a ahon pilut lai un,
ama'n ana angpom a, Pathian aphat hi,
"Toupa, tu'n ah zaw na thu bang zel in, na sikha khamuangtak in na paisak ding a;
na hotdamna ka mit in amuh tak ziak in,
huai michih muh dia na bawl tak;
Zentelte kiang a kilakna vak leh na mi Israelte thupina ding," achi hi.
Huan naungek thu agen anu leh apa'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Simeon in amau avualzawl a, anu Mari kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai naupang Israel lak a mi tampi pukna ding leh dinkhiakna ding a seh ahi, gensiat a om chiamtehna hi ding in leng.
Ahi, nang lungtang leng namsau in adawt pailet ding a; huchi a mi tampi in alungtang ua angaihtuahte uh alatna ding in,” achi hi.
Huan mi khat, amin, Anna, zawlnei, Phanuel Tanu, Asher nam a mi a-om a; amah tektak ahi a, anungak tawp nungsiah apasal kiang ah kum sagih a-om hi.
heading: Anna Phatna

paite: Kum sawmgiat-le-li ahih tanpha meithai in a-om a, ama'n tempul paisan lou in asun-azan in an ngawl a thum in Pathian abe zel hi.
Huchih laitak in amah ahong pai a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, Jerusalem tatna lamen peuhmahte kiang ah Jesu tanchin agen hi.
Huan Toupa dan bang zel a thil tengteng ahihzoh un, Galili gam a, amau khua Nazaret ah akik nawnta uhi.
heading: Nazaret Khua A Kikna

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, ahong hat hiaihiai a, pilna in adimta a, atung ah Pathian deihsakna a-om hi.
Huan kum teng in, Paikan Ankuanglui hun in, anu leh apa Jerusalem ah ahoh zel uhi.
heading: Tempul Ah Naupang Jesu

paite: Amah kum sawm-le-nih ahih in dan ngeina in ahohtou uhi.
Ankuanglui zoh a akik nawn lai un, Jerusalem ah naupang Jesu a-om lai a, anu leh pa'n athei kei uhi.
Huchi in apawlte lak ua om hi na'nteh achi ua, ni khat lam apai khin ua, asanggamte uh leh ameltheihte uh lak ah azong uhi.
Amuh louh ziak un zong kawmkawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum nung in, tempul ah, sinsak mite lak a tu a, athu uh na ngaikhia a, amaute thudong in, ava mu uhi.
Athu zate'n atheihdan leh adawndan lamdang asa mahmah uh.
Anu leh apa'n amah amuh un, lamdang asa mahmah ua; anu'n, akiang ah, "Tapa aw, bangziak a hichibang a hon hih na hia? Ngai in, na pa leh ke'n lungkhamtak in ka hon zong ua," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon zong na hi ua? Ka Pa inn a ka om ding na thei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
Huan akiang ua athugen atheisiam kei uhi.
Huan amau azuisuk a, Nazaret khua ahong tung ua, athu uh mang in a-om hi. Anu'n huai thil tengteng alungtang ah avom gige hi.
Jesu apil deuhdeuh a, ahong lian hiaihiai a, Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om deuhdeuhta hi.
